# Is the transition from JointModelComposite to JointModelFreeFlyer already verified by the original thread?

> **Current answer:** No. The maintainer only states that the JointModelComposite (Translation + SphericalZYX) is not fully supported and suggests using JointModelFreeFlyer; the original author has not returned the results of the replacement, and subsequent fixed-base joint anomalies were not addressed.
